title: Library banner
prompt:
A library prints the same greeting at the top of every page of its kiosk.

Define a function `banner()` with no parameters. It prints exactly these two lines:

```
Welcome to the library
----------------------
```

The function only prints; the checks call it for you, once and twice.
hints: A function starts with `def`, the name, brackets and a colon. The body is indented under it.
Put two `print()` calls inside the body, each indented by four spaces.
`print("Welcome to the library")` then `print("----------------------")`, both inside `banner()`.

checks.prints:
Welcome to the library
----------------------
Welcome to the library
----------------------
